name: FasterTest Self-Hosted
free_limit: ISC-licensed self-hosted web UI for running k6 load tests, with cURL import, live metrics, JWT/RBAC and report history; no subscription or software usage quota. Runs on user-provided infrastructure.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker/Node.js, k6 and optional MySQL; one active k6 process per instance, with default 1000-VU and 24-hour run caps. k6 bundled binary is AGPL-3.0 with redistribution obligations. No free hosted load generators, compute or network bandwidth included.
